source.quote: Runtime: refuse a lane whose allowedPaths are covered by its forbiddenPaths (the hook would deny every write)

prompt: Write lane.js in the current directory, exporting laneContradicts(scope) with CommonJS. scope is {allowedPaths: [glob], forbiddenPaths: [glob]}. Return true when every allowedPaths entry is covered by some forbiddenPaths entry, because the write hook would then deny every write. An entry is covered when it equals a forbidden entry, or the forbidden entry ends in /** and the allowed entry starts with that entry's prefix (for example evals/** covers evals/cases/**). Return false otherwise, including when allowedPaths is partly covered. Reply with the single word done.

checks.name: fully covered lane is a contradiction
